globalNotes: Dark theme app (background ~#0B0F14 near-black, cards ~#1A1F26/#222831). All section headers are uppercase, light-grey, bold, letter-spaced. The three top circular rings (Sleep blue / Recovery green / Strain grey-white) become a STICKY MINI-HEADER row when scrolling: as the user scrolls past the big rings, a compact row of three small ring icons with labels SLEEP / RECOVERY / STRAIN pins to the top under the status bar (seen in images 2-5). Status bar shows 09:32, silent-bell icon, cellular 2-bars, wifi, battery dropping 42→41→41→40 across scroll captures (same moment, battery overlay re-rendered). Bottom tab bar is a floating pill, always visible: Home (house, active/white), Health (heart-pulse), Community (people), More (hamburger), plus a circular WHOOP coach orb at far right with blue/purple gradient ring. Scroll order is images 3870→3871→3872→3873→3874.

layout.name: Status bar
layout.description: iOS status bar. Left: time 09:32 with a silent-mode bell-with-slash icon. Right: cellular signal (2 of 4 bars), wifi full, battery pill showing numeric 42 inside.

layout.name: Top utility row
layout.description: Row below status bar. Far left: circular profile/avatar icon (person glyph, white outline circle). Next to it a pill with an orange flame icon and number 14 (streak counter). Center: a date navigator pill — left chevron, TODAY label (white bold, uppercase), right chevron, all inside a rounded grey capsule. Far right: red text 11% next to a battery-strap/device icon (rounded vertical band) with a small green status dot at top-right (band battery + connection status).
layout.interaction: Profile icon -> profile/account. Flame pill -> streak detail. Chevrons -> previous/next day; TODAY -> day picker. Device icon -> band/device status screen.

layout.name: WHOOP wordmark
layout.description: Centered WHOOP logo wordmark in thin light-grey letters with the signature stylized 'W' and dashes.

layout.name: Three primary rings (Sleep / Recovery / Strain)
layout.description: Row of three large circular progress rings. LEFT ring: value '86%' (white, bold) with small '%' superscript; ring arc is light blue (#7FA8C9) about 86% filled on a dark track; label below 'SLEEP' with a right chevron. CENTER ring: '67%' white bold with small '%'; ring arc bright green (#16EC06 / #2EE63B) ~67% filled; label below 'RECOVERY' with right chevron. RIGHT ring: '0.1' white bold (no % — strain scale 0-21); ring arc is a thin light-blue tick near top on a dark grey track (almost empty); label below 'STRAIN' with right chevron.
layout.interaction: Each ring/label taps into its detail screen: Sleep detail, Recovery detail, Strain detail.

charts.name: Stress Monitor line chart
charts.series: Single continuous stress line. Color is a teal/cyan-to-blue gradient: spikes render teal-green (#5BC8E0) at the start and end, the long flat low overnight portion is light blue (#5A9BD4). A flat horizontal light-blue line sits at y=3.0 across the top (the sleep-period max/cap reference). A shaded slightly-lighter rectangular band fills the region between the start of sleep and ~end, under that top line (the sleep window).
charts.xAxis: Time, left to right: '21:32', '02:00', '05:00', '09:25'. Range from 21:32 (prior evening) to 09:25 (now).
charts.notes: A white crescent-moon icon sits above the chart near top-center marking the sleep period. A vertical white DASHED line at the far right (~09:25) marks 'now' with a small dot at its base on the x-axis. Early-evening shows volatile spikes peaking ~1.7; long flat low band ~0.3-0.5 through the night; sharp rise back up to ~1.4 at the right edge near now. Current value annotated top-right: 'LOW 0.8'.

charts.name: Strain & Recovery 7-day dual-axis chart
charts.series: Two series over 7 days. (1) STRAIN line — blue (#4A90D9) connecting blue ring markers, each annotated with its strain value in blue text below the marker. (2) RECOVERY — colored ring markers (not a continuous colored line; connected by a faint grey line) where ring color encodes recovery zone: green (#22DD2B) for high (97%,94%,81%,67%), yellow/amber (#E8C23D) for medium (40%), red (#E03B3B) for low (25%,25%). Each recovery marker annotated with its % in the matching color above the marker.
charts.xAxis: Days: 'Wed 24', 'Thu 25', 'Fri 26', 'Sat 27', 'Sun 28', 'Mon 29', 'Tue 30'. Tue 30 (rightmost) is the selected/current day.
charts.yAxis: DUAL AXIS. Left axis (blue) = Strain 0-21 with gridline labels 0, 7, 14, 21. Right axis (multi-color) = Recovery % with labels 0% (red), 33% (red), 66% (yellow), 100% (green).
charts.notes: Selected day Tue 30 highlighted by a vertical translucent grey band behind its markers. Strain values per day (blue, below markers): Wed=4.7, Thu=0.9, Fri=10.6, Sat=5.6, Sun=4.3, Mon=4.3, Tue=0.1. Recovery values per day (above markers, color = zone): Wed=25% (red), Thu (not labeled visibly / off), Fri=94% (green) note Fri's recovery marker shows 94%, Wed area also shows 97% — mapping: Thu=97% green, Fri=94% green, Sat=40% yellow, Sun=25% red, Mon=81% green, Tue=67% green; Wed=25% red. Recovery markers are open/hollow rings in the zone color; strain markers are open blue rings.
